nodes.description: Private owner address storage slot controlling access control via onlyOwner modifier.
Private storage slot for previous owner (declared, not used in logic).
Mapping of reflection (r) balances per address; mutated during transfers with arithmetic and reflection-rate math.
Mapping of token (t) balances per address (declared, effectively unused in this reflection implementation).
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances, written by _approve and read in transferFrom.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from fees; gates fee logic in _transfer and is set by owner functions.
Constant total token supply (1e9 * 10^9) used as tSupply denominator in rate calculation.
Total reflection supply, decremented by fee reflection in _reflectFee.
Accumulated token fees collected, incremented in _reflectFee.
Redistribution fee percentage applied on buys, set by setFee.
Tax/team fee percentage applied on buys, set by setFee.
Redistribution fee percentage applied on sells, set by setFee.
Tax/team fee percentage applied on sells, set by setFee.
Active redistribution fee used during the current transfer; swapped on buy/sell and zeroed by removeAllFee.
Active team/tax fee used during the current transfer; swapped on buy/sell and zeroed by removeAllFee.
Backup of the redistribution fee used by removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
Backup of the tax fee used by removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
Public blacklist mapping; blacklisted addresses are blocked in _transfer and set by blockBots/unblockBot.
Public mapping tracking per-address buy amounts (declared, not used in logic).
Payable development address authorized for manualswap/manualsend and excluded from fees.
Payable marketing address that receives ETH via sendETHToFee and is authorized for manualswap/manualsend.
Uniswap V2 router interface instance used for swaps and pair creation.
Liquidity pair address used to classify buys/sells and to gate fee logic.
Boolean flag controlling whether trading is enabled, set by setTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Boolean controlling whether automatic contract swaps occur, toggled by toggleSwap.
Maximum transaction amount enforced in _transfer and settable by owner via setMaxTxnAmount.
Maximum wallet holding enforced in _transfer and settable by owner via setMaxWalletSize.
Minimum contract token balance required before an automatic swap, set by setMinSwapTokensThreshold.
Deploys token: sets owner rOwned supply, initializes router, creates pair, excludes fee accounts, emits Transfer.
View returning the current owner address.
onlyOwner function that permanently sets owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to a new non-zero address.
External ERC20 transfer entry point; forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
External ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer then decrements allowance via _approve.
External approval entry point calling _approve for msg.sender.
Returns token balance by converting rOwned through tokenFromReflection.
Core private transfer logic: performs limits/blacklist checks and, before balance updates, triggers swapTokensForEth and sendETHToFee (potential reentrancy window).
Private allowance writer used by approve, transferFrom and swapTokensForEth.
Selects fee mode (removeAllFee/restoreAllFee) around the standard transfer.
Computes r/t values via _getValues and mutates _rOwned balances, team and reflection fees.
Credits the team/tax portion of reflections to the contract address in _rOwned.
Reflects fees by decreasing _rTotal and increasing _tFeeTotal.
Aggregates _getTValues, _getRate and _getRValues into r/t transfer values.
Pure helper computing tFee, tTeam and tTransferAmount from the active fee rates.
Pure helper computing rAmount, rTransferAmount and rFee from t values and the current rate.
Computes reflection rate as rSupply / tSupply from _getCurrentSupply.
Returns current rSupply/tSupply, falling back to totals when reflection supply is inconsistent.
Converts an rAmount to a token amount using the current rate; used by balanceOf.
Temporarily zeroes active fees, backing them up into _previousredisFee/_previoustaxFee.
Restores active fees from the previous fee backups.
lockTheSwap-guarded swap of contract tokens to ETH through the router using block.timestamp as deadline.
Sends contract ETH to the marketing address via a raw ETH transfer.
onlyOwner toggles the tradingOpen flag.
Privileged function restricted to development/marketing addresses that swaps the contract token balance for ETH.
Privileged function restricted to development/marketing addresses that forwards contract ETH to the marketing address.
onlyOwner loop adding addresses to the bots blacklist.
onlyOwner function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
onlyOwner setter for buy/sell redistribution and tax fee percentages.
onlyOwner setter for the minimum token amount triggering an automatic swap.
onlyOwner toggles the swapEnabled flag.
onlyOwner setter for the maximum transaction amount.
onlyOwner setter for the maximum wallet holding size.
onlyOwner loop toggling fee exemption for a list of accounts.
Untrusted caller address used for authorization (owner/development/marketing) and as the source of transfers.
Untrusted block timestamp used as the Uniswap router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
Raw ETH transfer to _marketingAddress, which can execute receiver logic and re-enter the contract.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens, an untrusted external call.
Arithmetic mutation of _rOwned/_rTotal reflection balances (SafeMath protected, but rate math is delicate).
Irreversible privileged ownership state change performed by renounceOwnership/transferOwnership.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, checked against owner/blacklist/limits.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer, checked against pair/blacklist/wallet limit.
Amount parameter of _transfer, compared to _maxTxAmount and wallet cap.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard passed into _getValues.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Buy redistribution fee parameter written by setFee.
Buy tax fee parameter written by setFee.

Address to remove from the blacklist in unblockBot.
Array of addresses to blacklist in blockBots.
Array of accounts whose fee exemption is toggled in excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.

Credited address parameter of transferFrom routed into _transfer.
Local holder of the contract token balance that is capped and passed to swapTokensForEth.

Local net transfer amount computed by _getTValues and emitted in Transfer.
Local reflection fee amount computed by _getTValues and forwarded to _reflectFee.

edges.reason: owner() returns the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner gate compares _owner with the caller before renouncing ownership.
msg.sender must equal _owner to pass the onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership depends on _owner.
msg.sender must equal _owner to transfer ownership.
transferOwnership performs a privileged ownership state change.
renounceOwnership irreversibly clears the owner slot.
constructor mints initial rOwned supply to msg.sender.
constructor writes _rOwned[_msgSender()] = _rTotal.
constructor initializes the uniswapV2Router state variable.
constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
constructor marks owner, contract and fee addresses as excluded from fees.
transfer forwards execution to the internal _transfer implementation.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve writes allowances through _approve.
_transfer finishes by invoking _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer zeroes fees via removeAllFee when no fee is taken.
_tokenTransfer restores fees via restoreAllFee after the transfer.
_tokenTransfer executes the standard reflection transfer.
_transferStandard reads all transfer values from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard performs subtraction and addition on _rOwned reflection balances that must not overflow or underflow.
_takeTeam adds the reflected team amount to the contract's _rOwned balance.
_reflectFee subtracts the rFee from _rTotal, an arithmetic-sensitive total.
_reflectFee adds the tFee to _tFeeTotal, an accumulating arithmetic value.
_getValues derives t values through _getTValues.
_getValues derives r values through _getRValues.
_getValues fetches the current reflection rate via _getRate.
_getRValues multiplies t values by the rate returned from _getRate.
_getRate obtains rSupply and tSupply from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads the constant _tTotal as the token supply.
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection receives the _rOwned balance of the queried account.
_transfer performs the token-to-ETH swap (external router call) before balances are updated.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to the marketing address before its own state updates complete.
swapTokensForEth performs an untrusted external router swap call.
The external router call can re-enter the swap path before state finalization.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the marketing address.
ETH transfer to a payable address can trigger a fallback that re-enters sendETHToFee callers.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router instance for approval and swap.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp directly as the swap deadline.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around the swap body to mitigate reentrancy.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to allow the router to spend tokens.
manualswap invokes the external-call-containing swapTokensForEth.
manualsend invokes the ETH-transferring sendETHToFee.
manualswap requires msg.sender to be the development or marketing address.
manualsend requires msg.sender to be the development or marketing address.
manualswap authorization compares the caller to _developmentAddress.
manualsend authorization compares the caller to _marketingAddress.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnSell.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnSell.
setFee is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes _swapTokensAtAmount.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSize writes _maxWalletSize.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
blockBots sets blacklist entries in the bots mapping.
unblockBot clears a blacklist entry in the bots mapping.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFee entries.
The active _redisFee is passed into _getTValues to compute the reflection fee.
The active _taxFee is passed into _getTValues to compute the team fee.
_transfer compares the amount against _maxTxAmount before proceeding.
_transfer compares balanceOf(to)+amount against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer rejects transfers when from or to is blacklisted in bots.
_transfer branches on uniswapV2Pair to distinguish buys and sells.
The from parameter drives source checks in _transfer.
The to parameter drives recipient checks in _transfer.
The amount parameter flows into limit checks and arithmetic in _transfer.
The tAmount parameter is consumed by _transferStandard for value computation.
The newOwner parameter becomes the privileged owner if non-zero.
The redisFeeOnBuy parameter is stored by setFee.
The taxFeeOnBuy parameter is stored by setFee.
The maxTxAmount parameter is stored by setMaxTxnAmount.
The notbot parameter is cleared in the blacklist by unblockBot.
The bots array parameter is iterated and blacklisted by blockBots.
The accounts array parameter is toggled in _isExcludedFromFee by excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
The sender parameter is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
The recipient parameter is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
local_contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount into swapTokensForEth.
local_currentRate is used to divide the reflection amount in tokenFromReflection.
local_tTransferAmount is emitted as the Transfer value in _transferStandard.
local_tFee is consumed by _reflectFee from _transferStandard.
local_tTeam is consumed by _takeTeam from _transferStandard.
local_rAmount is subtracted from the sender's reflection balance.
local_rTransferAmount is added to the recipient's reflection balance.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a transient argument only meaningful inside the _transfer access-control and limit checks.
to is a transient argument used only by _transfer for blacklist and wallet-size checks.
amount is a transient argument driving the arithmetic limits in _transfer.
tAmount exists solely to compute transfer values inside _transferStandard.
newOwner is only meaningful for the ownership assignment in transferOwnership.
redisFeeOnBuy is a setter argument consumed directly by setFee.
taxFeeOnBuy is a setter argument consumed directly by setFee.
maxTxAmount is a setter argument stored by setMaxTxnAmount.
notbot is used only to clear the blacklist entry in unblockBot.
the bots array exists only for the blacklist loop in blockBots.
the accounts array exists only for the exemption loop in excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
sender is forwarded directly from transferFrom into _transfer.
recipient is forwarded directly from transferFrom into _transfer.
the capped contract token balance is passed directly as the swap input amount.
the local rate is used only for the division performed in tokenFromReflection.
the net transfer amount is only used for the Transfer event in _transferStandard.
the computed reflection fee is immediately forwarded to _reflectFee.
the computed team fee is immediately forwarded to _takeTeam.
the reflection debit amount is only used to update balances in _transferStandard.
the reflection credit amount is only used to update balances in _transferStandard.
